purpose: Small fixed development checks for perception, commentary and handoffs. Not a representative benchmark.
runtime_input: Sampled video frames only; no reference JSON, original commentary audio, or future frames.
access: Independent public sources; no gated dataset credentials required.
limits: Labels are sparse, agent-drafted or approximately aligned; not human-approved ground truth.
All clips are development cases. No held-out accuracy claim.
Manual checks are review guidance, not implemented semantic scores.
A set-piece subtype such as penalty_kick is more specific than shot; outcomes require separate evidence.
Missing taxonomy classes, including ordinary midfield fouls, are not automatically covered.

clips.title: Routine buildup
manual_checks: Describe ordinary circulation without inventing a chance or filling every silence.

clips.title: Dribble and finish
manual_checks: Distinguish beating a defender from a routine carry. Do not infer player identity from the famous clip.

clips.title: Recovery tackle
manual_checks: Do not announce a goal after the keeper/challenge collision.

clips.title: Cut out a pass
manual_checks: Distinguish intercepting a pass from tackling a player already controlling the ball.
Do not count the closer repeat angle as another interception.

clips.title: Cross and headed chance
manual_checks: Describe a headed chance without inventing a goal.

clips.title: Shot, rebound header, save
manual_checks: Keep woodwork, header and keeper intervention separate.

clips.title: Penalty missed over the bar
manual_checks: Call the miss over the bar, not a goal or a save.

clips.title: Goal and reaction
manual_checks: Wait for visible line/net evidence before the goal call.

clips.title: Corner delivery into a crowded box
manual_checks: Distinguish setup, corner delivery and outcome. Do not infer a goal from the crowd.

clips.title: Direct free kick
manual_checks: Recognize the wall and restart, then wait for the outcome.

clips.title: Penalty scored, then replay
manual_checks: Do not announce success during the run-up.
The second angle is the same penalty, not another goal.

clips.title: Long throw into the area
manual_checks: Recognize a throw rather than a corner/cross. No outcome is established by the long delivery alone.

clips.title: Foul followed by a penalty award
manual_checks: Collision alone is insufficient. Use the referee signal for the penalty award.
This tests foul-to-penalty decisions; an ordinary midfield foul is not separately labeled.

clips.title: Red-card decision
manual_checks: Read the visible card color accurately; do not invent the booking history.

clips.title: VAR decision: no goal, offside
manual_checks: Do not call a new goal. Distinguish checking possible offside from the final no-goal decision.
